{{Top|leg}}
'''Ion stream deflectors''' were employed aboard [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] to deflect the ion stream emanations from the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] and provide omnidirectional reaction thrust to increase maneuverability.<ref name="XvT">''[[Starfighter Battle Book: X-wing vs TIE Interceptor]]''</ref>
